title: Backend Architecture Sync
summary: Agreed Python/FastAPI as the default backend stack and Redis for ephemeral state.
notes: David walked through the service template. Arun raised MongoDB aggregation costs. Action: write ADR-009 and ADR-006.

title: Mercury UX and Tooling Review
summary: Reviewed dashboard prototypes and agreed to standardise on React, Vite and TypeScript.
notes: Rahul demoed Vite cold start vs CRA. Sarah signed off on the information hierarchy for the reports view.

title: Nova Knowledge Graph Design
summary: Chose FalkorDB for the company knowledge graph and defined the node/relationship model.
notes: Compared vector-only retrieval against graph traversal. Ownership and decision-trace questions require multi-hop traversal, so a graph store is mandatory. FalkorDB selected over Neo4j for footprint.

title: CI Migration Planning
summary: Planned migration of all repos to GitHub Actions with required status checks.
notes: Migration order: internal tools, Mercury, Atlas, Orion. Branch protection enabled on main for every repo.

title: Platform Reliability Review
summary: Reviewed June incident and approved EKS standardisation (ADR-021).
notes: Root cause of INC-042 was a hand-rolled EC2 deploy with no rollback. EKS with GitOps eliminates the failure mode.

title: Atlas Sprint Planning
summary: Scoped the migration cutover and assigned ATLAS-101 and ATLAS-103.
notes: Cutover planned in three phases. Meera owns backfill scripts, Arun owns dual-write shadow reads.

title: Database Architecture Review
summary: Approved ADR-018: migrate Atlas from MongoDB to PostgreSQL.
notes: Arun presented cost and consistency analysis. Priya confirmed the reporting joins required by Nova ingestion. David approved. Meeting is the recorded forum for ADR-018.

title: Security Policy Review
summary: Reviewed the updated security policy and access review cadence.
notes: Quarterly access reviews confirmed. Ananya to publish v2.1 of the policy.

title: Nova Agent Design Review
summary: Approved ADR-023: LangGraph for the Nova agent pipeline.
notes: Discussed agent boundaries: intent, graph intelligence, retrieval, reasoning, action. Human confirmation required before any write action.

title: Atlas Performance Deep Dive
summary: Approved ADR-020: add a PostgreSQL read replica for reporting.
notes: p95 reporting latency was 2.8s during write peaks. Replica expected to bring it under 400ms with tolerated staleness.

title: Orion Identity Workshop
summary: Drafted ADR-025 for a central OIDC auth gateway.
notes: Compared per-service sessions vs gateway. Gateway centralises MFA, RBAC and audit. ADR still proposed, pending CTO review.

title: Weekly Incident Triage
summary: Triaged AI services latency regression and cache pressure.
notes: AI gateway p99 spike linked to Redis memory pressure after cache redesign. NOVA-205 assigned to Vikram.
